$comment: Screenplay's TypeScript lives in the Yarn workspaces under Source/ (screenplay-language, screenplay-editor, VSCodeExtension).
Only changes there trigger the frontend gates; managed .cratis/ai updates contain .ts files that are not part of the product (Cratis/AI#430).
There is no g:compile script. CI type-checks the language package (publish.yml builds @cratis/screenplay-language), so the compile gate
runs that package's compile, which includes its specs. screenplay-editor's compile is not part of CI and has pre-existing errors.
